integrity: The proof provides a global Rayleigh lower bound and matching spectral construction; finite computations are supporting checks, not proof of the infinite domain.
scientific_limitations: Symmetric stochastic kernels on helm graphs with integer rim size at least five; does not prove uniqueness of all unrestricted optimizers or analyze smaller sizes. Novelty remains conditional on discoverable literature; no independent validation.
title: Exact fastest mixing on helm graphs with at least five rim vertices
